name: Karui Akimichi
source:
Karui Akimichi is a former kunoichi of kumokagure's Team Samui. Karui is a dark-skinned kunoichi with long spiky red hair and amber eyes. Eventually, Karui moved to Konoha and married Choji, leading to her joining the Akimichi clan and having a daughter, whom they named [url=https://vndb.org/c105100]Chocho[/url]. As a mom, Karui seems more laid-back when it comes to her daughter Chocho's training, questioning the necessity for her to learn techniques in times of peace.
